name: Redjade Ginseng Plot
description: Cultivation plot adjusted for growing Redjade Ginseng. Soil quality is far better than the average arable land in Wuling. The wiki does not list a structured in-game recipe for operating the plot; the only Crafting table on the wiki is for building the plot itself (Redjade Ginseng Seed + Carbon -> Redjade Ginseng Plot). Rarity 3.
